Nadia F: Passing Nautilus Systems to CS (closed today). Deal notes: Private VPC deployment, EU data residency + GDPR audit log requirement, Okta SSO, initial footprint ~6M tokens/mo with nightly bulk enrich jobs that run for ~2 hours. They saw intermittent 502/timeout during peak enrich windows in POC. Renewal Oct 2027 (19mo). Customer lead: priya@nautilus.ai. Sales doc & contract: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/nautilus/contract>. Key asks: 1) verify SSO & SCIM onboarding 2) triage 502s during bulk enrich 3) provide short ops runbook for long-running ingestion jobs. @Theo R can you pick up CS lead?

Theo R: Ill take it. Quick asks: do we have a sanitized sample of their enrich job (concurrency + payload size)? Also need any procured IP allowlist or peering notes. Priya - can you drop sample manifest and confirm whether imports originate from their VPC workers?

Nadia F: Priya said shell upload a sanitized k8s job by EOD. IP allowlist was provided to sales, forwarding now. Contract notes: he escalations clause references SLA credits (section 4.3) if availability under agreed thresholds.

Theo R: Plan: 1) schedule 30m kickoff + ops sync (this week) 2) open ENG ticket to repro 502/timeouts 3) open SUP ticket for monitoring + alerting + incident playbook 4) create 1-pager ops runbook and schedule 45m enablement.

CSBot: Created task "nautilus-kickoff" (ID CS-982). ENG ticket ENG-1403 and SUP ticket SUP-881 created as placeholders.

Theo R: Tentative owners: CS lead - Theo R; ENG owner - Liam G; Support - Anika P; Enablement docs - Theo R.

Liam G: Ill take ENG-1403. Initial hypothesis: upstream proxy timeouts or connection teardown under high concurrency. Need the sample job and a short trace/log chunk showing the 502 to reproduce. If its our rate-limiter + long-running connections we may need to increase keepalive or advise chunked uploads.

Anika P: Ill own SUP-881. Ill add dashboard tiles: 5xx rate, connection lifetime, token-queue depth, and long-tail latency. Will draft an incident runbook focused on bulk-enrich failures and a playbook for when to enable temporary burst.

Theo R: Customer asks to capture cost guidance too  theyre sensitive to running big nightly jobs. Please include approximation of per-run cost and best practices (batch sizing, KV cache, stream vs blocking).

Liam G: Will simulate their job in staging once sample is uploaded. If we reproduce 502s, options: a) tune ingress/load-balancer timeouts b) suggest sharding or backoff in their importers c) propose short remediation window to increase ingress capacity during import windows. Ill report back in ENG-1403 within 48h.

Anika P: SUP-881 blocked until we have sample job and logs to calibrate alerts. ETA for dashboard & runbook draft: 3d after sample.

Theo R: Action items summary: - Theo: schedule kickoff + invite + ops agenda (due 2026-04-04) - Liam: ENG-1403 repro & recommendation (ETA 48h after sample) - Anika: SUP-881 dashboards & runbook (ETA 72h after sample) - Nadia: confirm procurement IP ranges + push for logs (by EOD) - CSBot: keep task statuses updated.

Nadia F: Noted. Ill also add a renewal-watch tag in CRM and schedule 60-/120-day health checks; sales flagged this as moderate risk (5/10) given reliance on nightly jobs.

Theo R: For the ops 1-pager Ill include quick commands for smoke testing (curl example), recommended env vars for chunk size, and a short fallback mapping (if OOM or throttle then route to smaller model). Example smoke snippet Ill include: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"x"}' https://private.nautilus.redwood/api/generate` and notes on parameterizing batch_size and concurrency.

Liam G: ENG-1403 created and assigned. Ill try a staged import with their concurrency profile and post raw metrics (95/99 latency, 5xx counts).

Anika P: SUP-881 created. Adding alert: >1% 5xx over 5m and token-queue growth >500.

Theo R: Good. Ill close this thread for now and reopen after kickoff with notes and next steps. Ping me if procurement asks for any contract language changes or remediation credits. :thumbsup:
